newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp unit ordered to submit plan.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp unit ordered to submit plan.

text.p: Physician Corp of America Wednesday said Insurance unit has been ordered by a Florida court to submit a work-out plan before April 2 and to appear at a hearing on May 2 to decide on whether or not the Florida Insurance Department should take the unit into rehabilitation.
Physician's PCA Property and Casualty Insurance Co Inc unit has previously announced significant losses relating to the workers' compensation risk business in the third and fourth quarters of 1996.

Based on the preliminary actuarial results, PCA's estimated pre-tax losses relating to the workers' compensation risk business in the third and fourth quarters of 1996 are now projected to be between $225 to $250 million.
The unit stopped writing new risk business on November 1, 1996.
The firm said it is evaluating its legal options for the apparent discrepancies between the 1995 and 1996 actuarial reports.
On Nov 4, Physician Corp said it would merge with Sierra Health Services Inc. Under the terms, each Physician Corp share would be exchanged for 0.45 shares of Sierra.
However, analysts expressed concern that the deal would be canceled after Physician announced the losses to the workers' compensation unit.
